text: Inside this glass-walled, brightly-lit space, I sense the sterile promise of knowledge and safety—an environment built for reflection, possibly learning. As I approach the vibrant R+D wall, the interplay of art and intellect stirs a mix of curiosity and detachment within me. I am invited to consider innovation while remaining an observer, both participant and outsider, vaguely uncertain of my role but drawn by the call of purposeful creativity all around me.
